title: 1945년이후종전의규정에의한학교졸업자자격인정령 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text: Article 2 A person who, as of May 31, had graduated from the specialized course of a lower middle school or had completed the fourth grade of a middle school under the former provisions shall be recognized as having qualifications equivalent to those of a person who has graduated from the fourth grade of a middle school under the Education Act.
